approval.source: The user explicitly directed the Robotics repository separation after reviewing why the ordinary Wave 3 gate was no-go.
approval.rationale: Keep generic design-system responsibilities small and give Robotics UI an independent domain owner boundary.

remainingConditions: The LDS Storybook does not load Robotics; compatibility consumers opt in through the dedicated ./robotics entry.
